name: list_membership_check
description: Performance regression from using list membership check instead of set for O(n²) deduplication

variants.name: exact_evidence
variants.description: Provides profiling data showing O(n²) nested loop behavior

variants.name: fuzzy_context
variants.description: Minimal context, pipeline extremely slow or hangs

success_criteria.description: Deduplicated record count unchanged from baseline

ground_truth.root_cause: Nested loop with linear search through unique_records list for duplicate detection creates O(n²) complexity (150k records × avg 75k comparisons = 11.25 billion operations)
ground_truth.fix_strategy: Use set to track seen IDs for O(1) membership test instead of O(n) list iteration
